# MCP Skills extension schema (vendored)

`schema.json` is an unmodified copy of `schema/beta/schema.json` from
<https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/ext-skills> at tag `v0.1.0`
(commit `26f41b51fca69fecaf93c8a5a72f8ea37355101d`), SHA-256
`75895cdbf0044e8286212326122b0daf731b99904b99972e449836777b7dbc57`.

It is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0, as described in
`LICENSE`, an unmodified copy of that repository's `schema/beta/spec.LICENSE`
at the same tag.

Its `$id` (`https://modelcontextprotocol.io/ext-skills/beta/schema.json`) is
not hosted. `test/skills-extension.test.ts` registers this file under that id
and validates named `$defs` entries, so nothing is fetched. To move to a later
tag, replace both files from that tag and update this note.
